hero.title: Connect with the right audience
hero.description: Build awareness, connect and form lasting relationships with a carefully curated audience.

sections.body: A curated programme of events bringing together executives, entrepreneurs, innovators and industry specialists across media and technology.
Partnerships are designed to create engagement before, during and after the event. Our programmes are designed to allow you to connect with our community.

blocks.title: Before the event
blocks.description:
Branding and recognition across event communications
Inclusion in relevant event promotion
Opportunities to help shape discussions and themes
Association with the event and its audience
Registration reporting

blocks.title: During the event
blocks.description:
On-site branding and presence
Opportunities to contribute to the programme
Participation in panels, discussions or case studies
Direct engagement with attendees

blocks.title: After the event
blocks.description:
Inclusion in event-related content where appropriate
Continued visibility through selected event covertage
Event attendance report
Ongoing association with The Media Collective community
Ongoing association with relevant Media Collective activity where appropriate

sections.heading: Visibility is only the start.
Ways to take part.
sections.body: For discussion-led events, partners can contribute to the programme in a variety of ways.

blocks.title: Share your vision
blocks.description: Bring your perspective to the programme through a keynote, case study, fireside chat or thought leadership.

blocks.title: Join the conversation
blocks.description: Take part in panel discussions and contribute your expertise and vision to topics that matter to the industry.

blocks.title: Present a case study
blocks.description: Share practical insights, experiences and lessons learned from real-world projects.

blocks.title: Host a session
blocks.description: Host a panel, fireside chat or focused session around a topic relevant to the audience.

blocks.title: Help shape the programme
blocks.description: Contribute ideas, themes and questions that could inform the event, while Media Collective retains responsibility for the final programme.

sections.body: Working with organisations across media and technology.

sections.heading: Talk to us about how we can connect you with our community.
People from across the industry.
sections.body: Representatives from these organisations have attended our events. They work across broadcasting, streaming, studios, sports and media technology.
